name: recall-skill
description: recall — capture & recall a terminal window's entire working context (commands, output, AI CLI conversation, diffs, git, trail). Kit = tooling, captured data lives in ~/.recall, never here.
author: pur4v

scripts.check: python3 -m py_compile skills/recall/scripts/recall.py skills/recall/scripts/adapters.py && for f in skills/recall/scripts/*.sh; do sh -n "$f"; done && bash -n skills/recall/scripts/recall.bash
